basic_details.short_information: DRDO LRDE Apprentice Recruitment 2026: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), Electronics and Radar Development Establishment (LRDE), Bengaluru, has released for engagement of 105 Apprentice Trainees under the Apprentices Act, 1961, for the financial year 2026-27. The vacancies include 43 Graduate Engineering Apprentices, 26 Graduate General Apprentices, 16 Technician Diploma Apprentices and 20 ITI Trade Apprentices. Candidates possessing a relevant Engineering Degree, General Graduation, Engineering Diploma or NCVT ITI certificate can attend the walk-in selection process. T

how_to_apply: Read the official advertisement for DRDO LRDE Apprentice Recruitment 2026.
Check the apprenticeship category, discipline and available vacancies.
Verify that you passed the relevant qualifying examination in 2024 or later.
Ensure your qualification was completed through a regular course.
Confirm that you satisfy the minimum age requirement.
Check that none of the previous apprenticeship or work experience restrictions apply to you.
Graduate and Diploma candidates should visit the NATS portal.
ITI candidates should visit the NAPS portal.
Complete the required apprenticeship registration and profile details.
Enter educational qualifications and marks accurately.
Download and print the completed NATS or NAPS profile.
Keep your original educational certificates and marksheets ready.
Prepare one self-attested photocopy set of the required documents.
Carry your Aadhaar Card, caste certificate if applicable, two photographs and Aadhaar-seeded bank passbook.
Attend the walk-in at LRDE, CV Raman Nagar, Bengaluru, on the date corresponding to your category.
Participate in the selection process conducted by LRDE.
Follow subsequent instructions for verification, medical fitness and apprenticeship contract execution if selected.
Important: NATS or NAPS registration does not itself guarantee selection. Candidates must attend the walk-in and satisfy all eligibility and document-verification requirements.

content_sections.heading: DRDO LRDE Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the prescribed qualification and satisfy the passing-year, age, training and employment restrictions mentioned in the notification. Only candidates who passed their qualifying examination in 2024 or later can participate. Important: The qualifying examination must have been completed through a regular course. Candidates who appeared for the examination but whose results have not been declared or are unavailable by the prescribed closing stage will not be considered. Yes. Candidates holding a recognized BE or B.Tech degree in one of the advertised Engineering disciplines can attend the Graduate Engineering Apprentice walk-in on 15 December 2026 if they meet the remaining eligibility conditions. Yes. The Graduate General Apprentice category includes B.Com., BBA, BCA and the specified B.Sc. and Library Science qualifications. Eligible candidates must attend the walk-in on 16 December 2026. Yes. Candidates with a recognized Engineering Diploma in the relevant advertised discipline can participate in the Technician Apprentice selection on 15 December 2026. Yes. Candidates with a valid NCVT certificate in one of the advertised trades can attend the ITI Trade Apprentice walk-in on 16 December 2026 after completing NAPS registration. No. Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under another organization are not eligible. Candidates with one year or more of training or job experience after acquiring their essential qualification are also ineligible.

ITI Qualification with Valid NCVT Certificate in the Respective Trade

content_sections.heading: DRDO LRDE Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly stipend during their one-year apprenticeship training. Stipend Clarification: The advertised amounts are apprenticeship stipends, not regular DRDO employee salaries. Completion of apprenticeship training does not guarantee permanent employment.

content_sections.heading: DRDO LRDE Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates should complete registration through the official NATS or NAPS portal and should not make payments to unauthorized agents.

content_sections.heading: DRDO LRDE Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: LRDE will select candidates based on the number of vacancies, applications and eligible applicants in the respective categories. The notification provides for the following assessment methods, as required: Verification of NATS or NAPS registration. Scrutiny of educational qualifications and eligibility. Shortlisting based on academic merit. Written test, where required. Interview, where required. Verification of original certificates. Character and antecedent verification. Medical fitness certification. Execution of the apprenticeship contract. Commencement of one-year training. Important: The notification does not prescribe a fixed written examination pattern, syllabus or mandatory written test for every category. LRDE may use academic merit, a written test or an interview according to its recruitment requirements.

content_sections.heading: DRDO LRDE Apprentice Walk-in Interview 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must attend the walk-in selection process at Electronics and Radar Development Establishment, Bengaluru, on their respective date. Electronics and Radar Development Establishment (LRDE), CV Raman Nagar, Bengaluru - 560093, Karnataka. Reporting Time: Candidates must report before 1000 hours (10:00 AM). No accommodation, transportation or transportation allowance will be provided by LRDE during selection or training.

content_sections.heading: DRDO LRDE Apprentice Recruitment 2026 NATS and NAPS Registration
content_sections.text: Registration on the relevant Government apprenticeship portal is mandatory before attending the walk-in.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DRDO LRDE Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: NATS or NAPS registration does not itself guarantee selection. Candidates must attend the walk-in and satisfy all eligibility and document-verification requirements.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for DRDO LRDE Apprentice Walk-in 2026
content_sections.text: NATS or NAPS profile printout. Class 10 marksheet and certificate. All semester-wise or year-wise marksheets of the qualifying examination. Degree, Diploma or ITI certificate, as applicable. Aadhaar Card. SC/ST/OBC or other applicable caste certificate. Two recent passport-size photographs. Bank passbook for an Aadhaar-seeded account. Selected candidates must also provide: Valid police verification certificate covering the last place of residence for at least one year and permanent address. Certificate of Physical Fitness in the prescribed format from an authorized Medical Officer of a Government Hospital. Any additional documents required for execution of the apprenticeship contract. Important: Candidates with CGPA or grade-based qualifications must produce the university or institution's official CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula during verification.

content_sections.heading: DRDO LRDE Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Training Duration
content_sections.text: The selected apprentices will undergo training for one year under the Apprentices Act, 1961, and applicable rules. The official notification states that LRDE is not obligated to offer employment to apprentices after completion of training.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for DRDO LRDE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DRDO LRDE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 105 vacancies: 23 Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) - Electronics & Communication Engg., 11 Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) - Computer Science & Engg. / Information Technology, 5 Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) - Mechanical Engg., 2 Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) - Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engg., 2 Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) - Civil Engg., 12 Graduate Apprentice (General) - B.Com. / BBA and 14 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DRDO LRDE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 15 December 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Electronics & Radar Development Establishment (LRDE), C V Raman Nagar, Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years (as on 1 December 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.12,300 for Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) - Electronics & Communication Engg., Rs.12,300 for Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) - Computer Science & Engg. / Information Technology, Rs.12,300 for Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) - Mechanical Engg., Rs.12,300 for Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) - Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engg., Rs.12,300 for Graduate Apprentice (Engineering) - Civil Engg..

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentice (Engineering): degree in engineering or technology. Graduate Apprentice (General): a degree. Technician Apprentice: diploma in engineering or technology. Trade Apprentice: ITI with NCVT certificate in the respective trade. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian Nationals only. Must be enrolled on NATS (graduate and diploma) or NAPS (ITI) portal. Marks in qualifying examination to be given in percentage; CGPA to be converted as per university norms.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Passed qualifying examination before 2024. Appeared in qualifying examination but result not declared by closing date. Candidates with higher qualification. Training or job experience of one year or more after attaining essential qualification.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Short listing on the basis of academic merit / written test / interview as required, depending on the vacancies available in various categories and disciplines. Verification of documents. Short listing on academic merit, written test or interview as required. Subject to satisfactory verification of documents.
